summary: Career workspace with four switchable views (internship board, hackathons, competitions, combined timeline) and drag and drop for moving applications between stages.
purpose: Lets the user track internship applications on a board and manage hackathons and competitions on one screen.
why: Likely reason: one place for all career tracking. The reason for the chosen layout is not stated in the code.
how: Holds which view is open, which entry form is shown, and which stage is active on phones. Handles dragging an application card and dropping it on a stage, which sets the new status. Draws a top bar with four view buttons that show counts, then the content of the chosen view. Only lines 1 to 120 of 434 were visible.
inputs: Internship, hackathon, and competition lists, plus update and delete actions, from the store. User clicks and drag gestures.
outputs: The workspace header with view buttons, the chosen view, and an updated application status after a drop.
risks: Dropping a card on a stage changes its status with no confirmation. Drag data is stored under two names to support two formats. Most of the file was not visible, so the full behaviour is unknown.
debug: If dragging does nothing, check that the card sets its drag data and that the drop area calls the drop handler. If a card lands on the wrong stage, check the stage it was dropped on. If a view is blank, check the list and count it reads.
